name: Ogyrvran

attributes.attribute: a giant who owned a cauldron
gave forth inspiration as sprites or fairies

sources: Spence, Lewis. The Minor Traditions of British Mythology. (New York: Benjamin Blom, Inc., 1972), 82.
Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Ogyrvran is a Welsh hero. Folklore and literature of Wales remember him as a giant. He kept a cauldron. From it came inspiration in the shapes of sprites or fairies. Some scholars link his name to Ogmios, the Celtic god of eloquence.

okr.objective: Ogyrvran is a Welsh giant whose cauldron gave inspiration.
